result.summary: Both slots pass with novelty 4 and soundness 4. Slot a (overnight vs intraday return split, N) is unchanged from attempt 1, so its scores are the same; seed 1 is struck because its |rho| with the reversal control is 0.53. Slot b (net payout / net issuance, N, draft 2) addressed every attempt-1 objection with real changes, not rewording: it now uses the NaN-safe cumulative ts_sum(ts_delta(x,1),241). All 8 seeds now clear the gate (coverage 0.998, distinct 0.715-0.917). Distinct follows event frequency, so it comes from real corporate actions rather than float32 rounding, and the 20-30% tie block sits mid-distribution, away from the long decile. None of slot b's seeds are struck. Two caveats on slot b. Seed 7 (cs_regres) is effectively a duplicate of seed 1, because its cross-sectional beta is about 0. If the vendor's share-count change and the price-adjustment factor change land on different days for bonus-share and rights issues, a spurious one-day spike could enter the long book; check this after evaluation. All three R groups pass with soundness 3. In R1 variant 2 and R2 variant 3 the PI changed only the wording, not the content; I still recommend deleting them.
